label: s2_side01_0080_rival_01
text: I got some soda![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0080_botan_01
text: Sugar and carbonation—my two love languages![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0080_brother_01
text: You find Peachy’s all right?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0080_rival_02
text: Yup, no problem! It’s so close-by![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0080_rival_03
text: There was nobody there, so I just left money\non the counter. Do you think that was OK?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0080_brother_02
text: Oh yeah, the old lady who runs it steps away\nsometimes, so everybody does that. No worries.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0080_friend_01
text: Man... I can’t imagine anyone getting away with\nthat back in Paldea![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0080_botan_02
text: Wait. Nemona. What’s all over your mouth?\nWere you eating snacks without us?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0080_rival_04
text: When I see a “Help yourself” sign, I don’t ignore\nit! There was just one mochi left, though.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0080_friend_02
text: Hey, Kieran! D’you have any idea how to change\nthe channel on this TV? It just keeps playing this\r\nsame tourism video over and over![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0080_brother_03
text: Oh—the caretaker hid the remote somewhere, so\nthat video’s all we can get on the TV.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0080_friend_03
text: OK, crew! New goal: find that clicker so we can\nall watch a movie or something![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0080_friend_04
text: It’s gotta be around here somewhere, right?!\nWe just need to find it![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0080_brother_04
text: Oh! Uh... Huh. Why didn’t I think of that?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0080_botan_03
text: Time to search this place top to bottom! And\nthen I vote we play games up on that big screen![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0080_rival_05
text: Haha, it’s like our own little Treasure Hunt!\nEveryone, grab a corner and start searching![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0080_select_01
text: I’m in!

label: s2_side01_0080_select_02
text: No way!

label: s2_side01_0080_friend_05
text: Heh heh! You agree my plan is genius, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0080_friend_06
text: What’s the matter—you worried we’ll get in\ntrouble or something? Just relax![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0080_brother_05
text: H-how about this, then...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0080_brother_06
text: Let’s say that whoever finds the remote gets to\ndecide what we do![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0080_friend_07
text: Hey! Kieran! No fair getting a head start![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0080_botan_npc
text: The caretaker wouldn’t have put it in one of the\nbathrooms...right?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0080_friend_npc
text: No luck with the drawers in the desk here! Guess\nthat would’ve been too obvious, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0080_brother_npc
text: Hmmm, the caretaker never really goes through\nhere, does he? Maybe it’s somewhere else...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0080_stopper
text: Everyone’s busy looking for the remote!\nYou can’t just leave them behind!
